book: FanDuel only (markets FanDuel does not post are used for training, never bet)
picker: six gradient-boosted picker versions averaged (depth 2/3/4, rate 0.1, leaf 50/150), retrained every week on every graded line before that week; inputs: FanDuel prices, model chances (incl. tuned layers), model-vs-line gap, line, game total, spread, home/away, dome, week, market
qualifies: picker edge over the FanDuel break-even >= 4 points; player has 3+ games for his current team; at most 1 pick per player and 2 per game
rank: by the picker's chance the under hits
parlays: 2-leg, $ flat, from the top 8 in rank order: #1+#2, #3+#4, #5+#6, #7+#8 (a leg skips to the next pick if the two share a game); with fewer boosts, place them in that order
boost: 30% profit boost on each parlay where available

why (2024 wk4 - 2026 wk5 replay, best ca.top 8 parlays in rank order: 143 parlays, 44% hit, +66% per $ staked with boost, 26 of 38 weeks up
why (2024 wk4 - 2026 wk5 replay, best ca.top 4 parlays (if only 2 boosts): 72 parlays, 51% hit, +86% per $ staked, 29 of 38 weeks up
